en.title: Subject and verb agreement
en.summary: The verb agrees with its subject in number.

paragraphs: The verb agrees with its subject in number. A singular subject takes a singular verb.
In the simple present only the third person singular has an ending: she works. Be has the most forms. The verb agrees with the real subject, not the nearest noun: The box of apples is heavy.
